Class ClusterNodeSessionHandler

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.network.ClusterNodeSessionHandler
public final class ClusterNodeSessionHandler extends Object
Handles encrypted TCP socket handshakes, heartbeat exchanges, and remote WorldBuffer chunk execution frames for both Master and Worker roles in ClusterCoordinator.
Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

    • handleWorkerHandshake

      public static void handleWorkerHandshake(Socket socket, AtomicBoolean running, EtherSecurityService securityManager, ConcurrentHashMap<String, ClusterCoordinator.ClusterNodeRecord> nodeRegistry, ConcurrentHashMap<String, DataOutputStream> workerSocketsOut, ClusterClockBarrier clockBarrier, Supplier<WorldBuffer> worldBufferGetter, Runnable onTopologyChanged)
      Handles an incoming worker socket connection on the Master node.
      Parameters:
      socket - accepted worker TCP socket
      running - cluster active flag
      securityManager - AES-256 frame cipher manager
      nodeRegistry - concurrent node registry
      workerSocketsOut - active worker output stream map
      clockBarrier - lock-step tick synchronization barrier
      worldBufferGetter - supplier of the Master's current WorldBuffer
      onTopologyChanged - callback triggered upon worker registration or disconnection
